channel.title: Paksh: Sports
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Rickelton Century Puts South Africa in Control vs. Bangladesh
item.description: Ryan Rickelton scored a century, putting South Africa in a strong position in the first test match against Bangladesh. Bangladesh's wicketkeeper also set a new record during the match. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Cowboys Defensive Coordinator Christian Parker Facing Scrutiny
item.description: Dallas Cowboys owner Jerry Jones has indicated that discussions are underway regarding the potential replacement of defensive coordinator Christian Parker. Parker is reportedly in a "hot seat" following Jones' comments, which suggest a… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.description: An undercard fight for the Tyson Fury vs. Anthony Joshua boxing event has been cancelled at short notice due to a star fighter withdrawing. The specific identity of the withdrawing fighter and the bout details were not provided in the… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Footballer's 12-game ban criticized after opponent's death
item.description: FC Andorra owner Gerard Pique has criticized the 12-game ban imposed on footballer Jesus Owono. The ban stems from a challenge that resulted in the death of Tenerife player Jesus de Miguel. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Ireland flyhalf Sam Prendergast cleared to play South Africa
item.description: Ireland flyhalf Sam Prendergast has been cleared to play in the Nations Championship against South Africa on Saturday. The 23-year-old was cited for dangerous play under World Rugby's new regulations, alleged to be a hip-drop tackle, but… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Erling Haaland's late goal sends Norway to Nations League quarter-finals
item.description: Erling Haaland scored a last-gasp penalty goal that secured Norway's place in the UEFA Nations League quarter-finals. The goal prompted celebrations from the Norwegian team. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: New Zealand cricketer Mitchell Santner to miss India Tests due to injury
item.description: New Zealand all-rounder Mitchell Santner will miss the upcoming Test series against India after sustaining a hand fracture. This injury represents a significant selection blow for the New Zealand team. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Romelu Lukaku Retires from Belgium International Football
item.description: Romelu Lukaku, Belgium's all-time top scorer, has announced his retirement from international football. The decision marks the end of his career representing the Belgian national team. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Illinois Stuns Duke with Record-Setting Performance
item.description: Andrej Stojakovic scored a record-setting 46 points to lead No. 10 Illinois to a 99-78 victory over No. 5 Duke. The win marked Duke's worst home loss since 1989. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Pochettino Departs Chelsea, Joins Manchester United
item.description: Mauricio Pochettino has departed Chelsea and is set to begin his role at Manchester United. He sent an emotional parting message after a win with the USA team. The Evening Standard provided an update on Manchester United's injury situation… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: JJ Gabriel Posts Farewell Message to Manchester United
item.description: JJ Gabriel has posted a goodbye message to Manchester United. This comes ahead of a proposed move to Real Madrid. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Elks Celebrate Grey Cup Victory with Fans
item.description: The Edmonton Elks, champions of the Grey Cup, held a celebration event with fans. During the event, quarterback McLeod "Mac" Fajardo announced his decision to remain with the team. Fans expressed a desire for the city to revive "City of… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Rugby Coach Rassie Erasmus Receives Six-Match Ban
item.description: Springbok coach Rassie Erasmus has been suspended for six matches following his criticism of the Television Match Official (TMO). The ban was imposed after Erasmus made remarks described as an 'unacceptable attack' and related to… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.description: In college football, Ohio defeated Ball State 35-28, with Nick Poulos scoring three touchdowns, including the go-ahead score. Separately, Miami (Ohio) secured a dominant 20-3 win over Kent State, with Jones contributing two touchdowns to… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: MS Dhoni Retires from IPL, Appointed Chennai Super Kings Mentor
item.description: Mahendra Singh Dhoni has retired from the Indian Premier League (IPL), with Chennai Super Kings (CSK) announcing his appointment as team mentor for the 2027 season. Dhoni's playing career concluded in the IPL, and he will now guide the… Coverage: Left 4 · Centre 6 · Right 7.

item.title: Xavier defeats Cleveland State in basketball game
item.description: Xavier University secured a 75-67 victory over Cleveland State University in a basketball game. The win for Xavier was described as a survival of a scare from Cleveland State. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Drake Maye Suffers Serious Ankle Injury, Expected to Miss Extended Time
item.description: Drake Maye, a player for the Patriots, is expected to miss an extended period due to a serious ankle injury. Sources indicate the injury could potentially keep him out for the remainder of the year, placing the Patriots' season on the… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Fantasy Football Week 11 Defense Rankings Released
item.description: Rankings for fantasy football defenses for Week 11 have been released, offering guidance on top streamers and players to start. The rankings are intended to help fantasy league players make strategic decisions for the upcoming games. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: NFL Player Injury Status Updates Ahead of Week 12 Games
item.description: Micah Parsons of the Packers is expected to make his season debut against the Rams on Thanksgiving Eve. Separately, there is a possibility that Davante Adams of the Rams could play against the Packers in Week 12. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Fernando Mendoza Makes Raiders Debut, Named Rookie of the Year Favorite
item.description: Quarterback Fernando Mendoza made his debut start for the Las Vegas Raiders. Following his performance, former NFL players have reacted to his start. Mendoza has also been highlighted as a leading candidate for NFL Rookie of the Year. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Alouettes Stand By Quarterback Davis Alexander After Grey Cup Loss
item.description: The Montreal Alouettes football team has stated they will continue to support quarterback Davis Alexander following their loss in the Grey Cup. Players expressed their admiration for Alexander's performance, with one quoted as saying… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Detroit Mercy and Eastern Michigan Face Off in Basketball
item.description: Detroit Mercy is set to play Eastern Michigan in a basketball game, with Detroit Mercy aiming to break a three-game losing streak. In a separate game, Western Michigan defeated Eastern Michigan with a final score of 34-27 after building an… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Leafs GM Chayka Addresses Team's Struggles, Trade Possibilities
item.description: Toronto Maple Leafs General Manager John Chayka has described the team's recent skid as 'unacceptable' and stated he is open to making trades, particularly for defensemen. He also expressed support for head coach Jim Hiller. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: England cricketer Jacob Bethell to undergo knee surgery
item.description: England cricketer Jacob Bethell will undergo knee surgery and consequently miss the upcoming tour of South Africa. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Juan Mata, World Cup winner, retires from football at 38
item.description: Spanish World Cup-winning footballer Juan Mata has announced his retirement from the sport at the age of 38. The midfielder, who was part of Spain's 2010 World Cup-winning squad, has decided to end his playing career. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Bihar Cricket Team Defeats Delhi in Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy Match
item.description: In the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy, the Bihar cricket team achieved a victory against a Delhi team that included star players. Despite Delhi's Yash Dhull scoring 125 runs off 59 balls, Bihar successfully chased a target of 225 runs, winning by… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Florida Gators Basketball Player Suffers Shoulder Injury During Game
item.description: Boogie Fland, a guard for the No. 1 Florida Gators men's basketball team, sustained an apparent shoulder injury during a game against the Notre Dame Fighting Irish. Fland left the game due to the injury. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Rookie Scores NHL Debut Winner
item.description: Rookie forward Alex Boucher scored the game-winning goal in his NHL debut for the Ottawa Senators. The Senators defeated the Winnipeg Jets with Boucher's goal, which helped them move to the top of the Atlantic Division standings. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: US Women's Hockey Team Wins World Championship
item.description: The U.S. women's national hockey team defeated Canada 6-2 to win the World Championship. Veteran Hilary Knight scored two goals in the victory, securing the team's second consecutive championship title. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Zverev and Fils Advance at ATP Finals
item.description: Alexander Zverev defeated Jodar in two sets to advance in the ATP Finals, a tournament for the world's top eight players. Zverev, a previous winner in 2018 and 2021, secured a break in each set against the 20-year-old Spaniard. Jodar, who… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Jay Shah Reappointed ICC Chairman, Shah Rukh Khan Congratulates
item.description: Jay Shah has been reappointed as the Chairman of the International Cricket Council (ICC) for a second term. The reappointment was unopposed. Actor Shah Rukh Khan congratulated Jay Shah on his reappointment, stating that his leadership is… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: IPL Teams Trade Players Mohammed Shami and Sam Curran
item.description: Ahead of the IPL 2027 season, the Lucknow Super Giants have traded bowler Mohammed Shami to the Rajasthan Royals. In a separate transaction, Sam Curran has moved to the Lucknow Super Giants. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Bengals cancel trade with Eagles over draft pick protection
item.description: The Cincinnati Bengals have backed out of a trade with the Philadelphia Eagles that would have sent defensive end Arnold Ebiketie to the Eagles. The Bengals' decision was made to protect a 2027 compensatory draft pick. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: College Basketball: Duke vs. Michigan State Matchup Highlighted
item.description: The college basketball season features a notable matchup between No. 2 Duke and No. 5 Michigan State, with Jordan Scott of Michigan State being highlighted for his defensive and rebounding performance in the game. The contest is part of a… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Vincent Kompany Returns to Bayern Training with Arm in Sling
item.description: Vincent Kompany, the manager of Bayern Munich, returned to the club's training ground with his arm in a sling. The reason for his injury was not specified in the coverage. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: World Series Champion Bob Boone Dies at 78
item.description: Bob Boone, a World Series champion and a member of Major League Baseball's first three-generation family of players, has died at the age of 78. Boone was a catcher for the Philadelphia Phillies and was part of the 1980 World Series-winning… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Canadian Centre Edey Finding His Footing with Grizzlies
item.description: Canadian centre Edey is reportedly finding his footing with the Grizzlies. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Six Inducted into Hockey Hall of Fame
item.description: Six individuals, including former NHL players Carey Price and Patrice Bergeron, have been inducted into the Hockey Hall of Fame as part of the class of 2026. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Bills defeat Vikings 23-6 in Monday Night Football
item.description: The Buffalo Bills secured a 23-6 victory over the Minnesota Vikings in a Monday Night Football game. The Bills' defense played a key role in turning the game around, contributing to the win that moved the Bills to a 7-1 record. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Grey Cup Teams Arrive in Calgary for Championship Game
item.description: The Edmonton Elks and Montreal Alouettes football teams have arrived in Calgary for the 113th Grey Cup championship game. As part of a tradition, a horse named Taffy is scheduled to be led through a Calgary hotel. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.
